item.name: Provides Information About Scheduled Views Quota

request.description: Every customer can use a limited number of scheduled views. This endpoint allows learning about these limitations and remaining quota.

response.name: Current state of scheduled views quota usage (limit and remaining).

item.name: Get A List Of Scheduled Views

query.description: Limit the number of scheduled views returned in the response. The number of scheduled views returned may be less than the `limit`.

Continuation token to get the next page of results. A page object with the next continuation token is returned in the response body. Subsequent GET requests should specify the continuation token to get the next page of results. `token` is set to null when no more pages are left.

request.description: Get a list of all scheduled views in the organization. The response is paginated with a default limit of 100 scheduled views per page.

response.name: A paginated list of scheduled views in the organization.
